extracted.name: Floral gin pitcher
extracted.description: Combine gin, elderflower liqueur, rose syrup and freshly squeezed red grapefruit juice to make this summery floral gin pitcher. Serve with grapefruit slices
ingredient_lines: 150ml freshly squeezed red grapefruit juice plus grapefruit slices to serve
instruction_lines: Tip some ice into a large pitcher and stir in the gin, elderflower liqueur, rose syrup and grapefruit juice.
Top up with tonic water and stir. Garnish with grapefruit slices and a rosemary sprig.
